about_short_description.short_description: Jellyfish is the leading intelligence platform for AI-Integrated engineering, helping companies use AI to transform how they build software.

product.name: Jellyfish Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software engineering intelligence platform that combines developer-tool data to measure engineering productivity, delivery performance, resource allocation, AI usage, and business impact.

product.name: Jellyfish AI Impact
product.description: A solution for measuring AI coding-tool adoption, usage, cost, workflow effects, and engineering outcomes across the software development lifecycle.

product.name: Jellyfish Operational Effectiveness
product.description: Engineering management analytics for monitoring team performance, analyzing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and improving delivery predictability.

product.name: Jellyfish Business Alignment
product.description: Engineering and product planning capabilities that connect roadmap priorities, resource allocation, execution data, and business outcomes.

product.name: Jellyfish DevEx
product.description: A developer-experience analytics solution that combines developer surveys with engineering data to identify workflow friction and guide productivity improvements.

product.name: Jellyfish DevFinOps
product.description: A financial operations solution that connects engineering activity and business data to automate software capitalization, R&D tax-credit tracking, and development-cost reporting.
